nodes.name: 0021-chainlit-adapter-ouroboros-loop.md
nodes.summary: ADR that made Chainlit on port 8000 an adapter over the Ouroboros agent loop (not LangGraph), with :8765 remaining an internal gateway. Status is superseded for the click target by ADR 0026 (Streamlit Dashboard).

nodes.name: 0022-live-stubs-die-infra-nets.md
nodes.summary: Accepted ADR forbidding host patches of live model output (fake citations, out-of-scope dictionaries, chunk restore/re-rank, route lists as routers) while allowing infra safety nets on timeout, HTTP 500, or empty completions.

nodes.name: 0023-main-openrouter-glm52-free.md
nodes.summary: ADR that pinned Main chat to OpenRouter z-ai/glm-5.2:free with thinking off and loud failure on missing keys or dead :free ids. Status is superseded for chat by ADR 0027 (DeepSeek direct API).

nodes.name: 0024-readme-names-ouroboros-evolve-off.md
nodes.summary: Accepted ADR requiring the README to name Ouroboros as the conversation runtime, domain tools as reviewed skills, and /evolve off (runtime_mode=light) so graders do not mistake the demo for LangGraph.

nodes.name: 0025-openrouter-embeddings-no-local-torch.md
nodes.summary: Accepted ADR that retrieve/ingest must call a remote OpenAI-compatible embeddings API (default LAN LM Studio e5) with no local Torch, SentenceTransformer, or baked Hugging Face weights; Chroma still stores vectors in-process.

nodes.name: 0026-streamlit-dashboard-is-the-demo.md
nodes.summary: Accepted ADR making the Streamlit Dashboard at :8000 the demo chat UI: session-start web rail, Brent forecast chart, and report corpus strip around chat, with Streamlit calling Ouroboros run_turn and Chainlit removed from the demo image.

nodes.name: 0027-deepseek-direct-api-main.md
nodes.summary: Accepted ADR pinning Main chat to deepseek-v4-flash via DeepSeek API on the openai-compatible Ouroboros lane, thinking off, with compose splitting DEEPSEEK_API_KEY to ouroboros and OPENROUTER_API_KEY to analyst embeddings.
